paywall.quiz.faq.a3.noTrial: No. No commitment: cancel whenever you want from the Play Store, and you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.
paywall.quiz.faq.q3.noTrial: Am I tied into a commitment?
paywall.quiz.faq.a3: Yes — before the free trial ends, and anytime after. The free trial is there so you can discover the app and everything it offers.
paywall.quiz.faq.q3: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
paywall.quiz.faq.a2: Yes. Sophia Pro also unlocks Sophia Training: active memorization that has you review at the right moment so what you learn sticks for good.
paywall.quiz.faq.q2: Does Sophia Pro include Sophia Training?
paywall.quiz.faq.a1: Yes. Go to the Play Store → your account → Subscriptions → Sophia → Cancel. Done in a few taps.
